senses.zh_definition: 肯尼：英语人名，常用作 Kenneth 的昵称；具体指谁须根据上下文判断。
senses.en_definition: A personal name, commonly a familiar form of Kenneth.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang dalam bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya bentuk panggilan mesra bagi Kenneth.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 表示专有名词。通常写作 Kenny。资料包不足以确认其为正式马来语词条，status 因而标为 unverified；所列马来语释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文。频次排名仅沿用资料包，不能证明马来语词汇资格。搭配为马来语姓名使用结构，不代表已核实的频率统计。姓名关系与读音参见 [Behind the Name: Kenny](https://www.behindthename.com/name/kenny)。

etymology.historical_story: Kenny is used in Scottish and English naming traditions as a familiar form of Kenneth. Its connection with a longer personal name explains why it functions as a name rather than a descriptive Malay word. When it appears in a Malay sentence, it identifies a person; it does not acquire Malay affixes or a separate dictionary meaning. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/kenny).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式初次称呼可使用 Encik Kenny；已有职衔或对方指定称呼时，依其偏好使用。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 姓名首字母通常大写。不能仅凭 Kenny 推断国籍、族群、宗教，或擅自将其扩写为 Kenneth。
